LanguageData.LP_DragonLair.label: dragon lair
LanguageData.LP_DragonLair.description: A true dragon's lair: it sleeps by its hoard, with guards around it.
LanguageData.LP_DragonLair.arrivedLetter: This is a dragon lair. The lair's master sleeps by the hoard and wakes when anyone comes within 10 cells. In the lair it gets one extra legendary resistance and a lair action every 10 seconds; lure it more than 20 cells out of the lair and the lair actions stop.
